description: This file defines LESS mixins for creating various gradient backgrounds, such as horizontal, vertical, directional, and radial gradients, along with gradient patterns with multiple colors. It is a helper file intended to be included in other LESS stylesheets for styling UI elements.

methods.name: horizontal
methods.description: Creates a horizontal linear gradient with specified start and end colors, including vendor-specific syntax and fallback filter.

methods.name: vertical
methods.description: Creates a vertical linear gradient with specified start and end colors, including vendor-specific syntax and fallback filter.

methods.name: directional
methods.description: Creates a gradient at a specified angle with given start and end colors.

methods.name: horizontal-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a horizontal gradient involving three colors, with a specified color stop percentage.

methods.name: vertical-three-colors
methods.description: Creates a vertical gradient involving three colors, with a specified color stop percentage.

methods.name: radial
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient with inner and outer colors.

methods.name: striped
methods.description: Creates a striped pattern with specified color and angle.
